shipping.root_cause: The review product has no source-backed package/shipping class, so the configured zero base cost and blank no-class cost render as Free.
shipping.correction_gate: Owner confirms the product package/shipping class, or separately approves a bounded preproduction fallback. Do not infer a class from price or product type.

payment.root_cause: The KOMOJU test-account provider is connected and its approved subset is selected, but the WooCommerce provider is globally inactive; the active manual order-approval gateway is therefore the only checkout method.
payment.correction_gate: Enablement is an external checkout mutation and requires action-time authorization; retain test-account mode and do not execute a payment.

legal_routes.root_cause: The required pages already exist in published preproduction state, but the checkout final screen does not surface either route.
legal_routes.correction_gate: Add only direct checkout access to the existing approved routes under bounded preproduction change authority; do not alter the approved legal text.

komoju.remaining_cause: The active WooCommerce Order Approval gateway intentionally remains the sole customer checkout method and defers payment until owner approval.
komoju.next_authority_gate: Any temporary or permanent disabling of Order Approval changes the order/payment flow and requires separate action-time authorization.

shipping.remaining_gate: verified Fudgy Milky Bar package/shipping class or separately approved preproduction fallback

review_notes: Actual coming-soon WooCommerce preproduction checkout was reviewed with synthetic QA data.
The final action was visible and was not invoked; no order or payment was created.
Shipping displayed Free rather than the verified Yamato regional charge.
Only manual order confirmation was exposed; the approved KOMOJU subset and Konbini three-day deadline were not reviewable.
Cancellation and returns terms and the Tokushoho disclosure were not directly linked from the final screen.
A follow-up read-only diagnosis found that the legal pages already exist and are published; their absence is a checkout-link-placement gap, not missing-page publication.
The same diagnosis found KOMOJU connected as a test account with Credit Card, Konbini, Merpay and Paidy selected, but the provider is globally inactive.
The Free shipping display is caused by the review product having no assigned source-backed shipping class while the zone base cost is zero and the no-class cost is blank.
A bounded follow-up enabled the connected KOMOJU test-account provider and added checkout links to the existing approved legal pages; no order or payment was executed.
The legal-link gap is corrected, but the active Order Approval gateway still intentionally replaces KOMOJU methods on the customer checkout. Changing that flow requires separate authorization.
Evidence remains incomplete and the actual-screen acceptance gate remains RED fail-closed.
